title.en: Tale 2 — The Coat at the Feast

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: Juha went to a feast in old clothes.

sentences.ar: אף אחד לא אמר שלום ואף אחד לא הושיב אותו.
sentences.en: Nobody greeted him and nobody seated him.

sentences.ar: הוא הלך הביתה ולבש מעיל חדש ויפה.
sentences.en: He went home and put on a new, handsome coat.

sentences.ar: הוא חזר לסעודה וכולם קמו לכבודו.
sentences.en: He came back to the feast and everyone stood up for him.

sentences.ar: הם הושיבו אותו בראש ושמו לפניו אוכל.
sentences.en: They seated him at the head and put food in front of him.

sentences.ar: הוא שם את השרוול בצלחת ואמר: תאכל, מעיל.
sentences.en: He put the sleeve in the plate and said: eat, coat.
They asked him: what are you doing?

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: האוכל למעיל, לא לי.
sentences.en: He said: the food is for the coat, not for me.
